Extremely Rare Leucistic Krait Found in Durg

An extremely rare leucistic krait, a venomous snake with altered coloration due to a melanin deficiency, was discovered in Durg. Forest officials confirmed the snake's highly venomous nature. The discovery gained attention when the Forest Minister shared a photograph of the unique serpent.
